description: A project's hard rules: short never/always rules from the user, shown first in every brief and not cut. add: one sentence, max 300 chars; 25 rules, 2,000 chars in total. Added or removed rules wait in the user's review queue until the user approves them (on their review page; no app can). list: active rules. remove: requires a user_request quoting the user; it waits like add; the rule is kept as removed. Preferences and lessons are recorded separately. Requires project. Returns the rule or {rules}.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

model.description: Model name if known. Unknown names are omitted.

rule.description: add: the rule, one short sentence.

rule_id.description: remove: the rule's id (R<id> in the brief).

user_request.description: remove (required): the user's own words asking to remove it.

name: manage_rules
